metadata.input: ['echo TPOT_BEGIN; uname -r; hostname; nproc; grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo; awk \'/MemTotal/ {print $2}\' /proc/meminfo; df -h | awk \'FNR == 2 {print "[" $4 "]"}\'; df -h | awk \'NR == 2 || NR == 3 {printf "%s ", $0} END {print ""}\'; df -k | awk \'FNR == 2 {print "[" $4 "]"}\'; cat /etc/os-release; echo TPOT_PY; python3 -c \'print(1)\'; echo TPOT_AFTER; echo TPOT_APT; apt-get install nosuchpkg; echo TPOT_END', 'exit']
